name: harvey-labs
tagline: A benchmark built to evaluate and improve agent capabilities for supporting legal work
description: harvey-labs is Harvey's open benchmark for evaluating and improving AI agents that support legal work. It defines tasks and metrics that reflect real legal workflows — research, drafting, review — so agent teams can measure whether their systems actually help lawyers. The project comes from Harvey, a major player in legal AI, and signals a shift toward open evaluation in a traditionally closed vertical.
highlights: First open agent benchmark for legal work from a major legal-AI player
Measures real legal workflows: research, drafting, review
953 stars and strong interest in legal agent evaluation
Sets a standard the legal-AI ecosystem can build on
curatorNote: Legal AI is famously closed; an open benchmark from Harvey is a notable exception. If legal agents are going to be trusted, they need public yardsticks like this one.
